learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basic principles and operating mechanisms of renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, hydro, biomass, geothermal, and marine energy.
Perform basic calculations such as energy potential, power, efficiency, and capacity factor in renewable energy systems.
Analyze renewable energy systems within the framework of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer.
Design, size, and select components of a suitable renewable energy system for a given application.
Evaluate the environmental, economic, and sustainability impacts of renewable energy systems.
Follow current technologies, standards, and software in renewable energy and prepare projects and presentations.
